experiments.title: Root-zone soil and static maps on the patch-2 residual
experiments.delta: Residual inputs. Patch size stays 2. Loss, files, split, and width stay as det_v2_reslim_patch2.
protocol: Add root-zone soil and the static maps (land-sea mask, orography, land cover, latitude) to the 1 degree residual. The attention trunk does not gain a new field.
Patch size 2, embed 64, depth 4, 4 heads, keep ratio 0.25, learning rate 0.0001, patience 20, global residual loss, one map per step.
Save as runs/det_v2_reslim_patch2_soilresid. A patch-2 checkpoint does not load into it.
Do not start this run until the PI accepts the referee brief.
experiments.success_criterion: 2019 four-week valley temperature mean below 0.767 K; January at or under 0.597 K; July no worse than 1.211 K; April ahead of 1.090 K. Report global temperature RMSE and valley precipitation. April rain is read against the patch-2 mean of 0.0301 m and the observed week.

explicitly_rejected.reason: det_v2_soil_k9 already made July worse than the historical week, and rain stayed on the reference. blocks_reproposal.
det_v2_reslim_valley and det_v2_reslim_valley01 are scored and retired. blocks_reproposal.
det_v2_reslim_patch2 is the same trunk without a residual delta. Valley temperature got worse.
H_spring_week_vs_season stays open. The spring files are 23 channels. Training them now drops the soil channel that produced the 0.767 K result.
850 hPa is the July field and waits on a trunk that can change a valley cell. A daily temporal convolution is a later lever, after the residual score.
